produced_by: genre-choice skill, run by an agent with the repo as its working directory

image_prompt.text: A massive stylized blocky mountain filling roughly a 1000x1000 stud base, built as stepped terraces of block and wedge parts, rising to a single high peak at the centre
Multiple winding roads at least 20 studs wide, switchbacking up the terraces from the base of the mountain to the summit and drivable along their whole length
Guardrails running along the outer edge of every road wherever it overlooks a drop
Three distinct material bands up the slope: a grassy base, rocky grey mid-sections, and a snow-capped peak
Flat plateaus and pull-off areas cut into the terraces alongside the roads
Clean, blocky, game-like Roblox aesthetic: flat untextured colour on simple parts, no organic sculpting

layout_placement.text: Mountain height, road width, and number of switchback turns exposed as editable attributes on the build
Grass base colour, rock colour, snow colour, and road colour exposed as editable palette attributes

notes: Classification was close between Racing and Simulation. Resolved by the Racing boundary rule: no lap and no finish condition means Vehicle Sim, so the P6 route does not apply. Entertainment (environment demo) and no-genre were also considered and rejected; neither was loaded for options.

Preset caveat: took Vehicle Sim but dropped its resource-shared option. The prompt has no extraction loop, and the Simulation notes warn that the shared resource field is common ground for a hauling loop that does not exist here.
Vehicle Sim has no plot, which is why the shape is world-shared rather than either BuildZone shape.
Pipeline: no selected row carries a modifier, but the stepped terraced mountain is real elevation with no overhang, so P0 + tiered. If the terracing is not captured the mountain builds flat.
Watch for overhang: the switchback roads must sit on terrace shelves rather than cantilever out over the slope below. If they cantilever, this becomes P2.

Guardrails correspond to the barrier-guardrail concept in the Racing file, but Racing was rejected as a genre, so they are emitted as free text with a null id rather than borrowing an ID from an unloaded file.
The editable-attribute request is a property of geometry rather than geometry itself, so it is routed to layout_placement per the step 5 rule. No loaded option covers attribute exposure.
The prompt names no gameplay loop at all: no objective, job, economy or spawn. Only the drivable world was built.

would have asked: Sounds like one shared open world with vehicle-width roads winding up a terraced mountain, plus the guardrails, the grass/rock/snow banding and the roadside plateaus you described. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself? (Chose it and dropped the preset's resource field.)

would have asked: Is this free driving, or do you want a timed run or a finish line at the summit? A lap or finish would reclassify this as Racing and force the P6 procedural-route build, which is a slower and more constrained pipeline.
would have asked: Should the summit or the larger plateaus be gathering or photo spots for players, which would pull in showcase options?
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
